name: trap-bar-row
instructions:
1. Step inside of a trap bar and hinge forward until your torso is roughly parallel with the floor (or slightly above).
2. Grasp the bar with a neutral grip and then begin the movement by driving the elbows behind the body while retracting the shoulder blades.
3. Pull the bar towards your belly button until the upper back musculature has completely contracted.
4. Slowly lower the bar back to the starting position under control.
5. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
